Dashboard Parts in Figma

9 Oct 2026. The seven dashboard parts that joined the SAMAVESH design system now have Figma masters in the library, composed from existing library parts and bound to the same tokens the code reads.

What Changed

WhatBeforeAfterWhy
A Dashboard page in the Figma libraryDid not exist; docs pages said 'not yet drawn'New page after Map of India: seven masters, a documentation frame, a component recordDesigners can now place every dashboard part instead of redrawing it
Headline Figure masterNoneSize XL/LG/MD × Default/Inverse, with value, label and contextThe cards and the band are built from it, as in code
Dashboard Card masterNone6 tones × with/without link, mark, note and facts switchesThe card a 'choose a dashboard' page is made of
Headline Band, Dashboard HeaderNoneBand: 0/1/4 side figures · Header: 6 tones, 9 switchesThe two coloured bands a dashboard opens with
Area Breakdown, Area ExplorerNoneMap + ranked list (1 or 2 measures) · map + highest/lowest or picked StateState/UT panels, from the library map and ranked list
KPI View masterNone8 kinds, each a real Chart Card with its chart swappedA KPI is placed by the shape of its data
Library Index98 pages, no Dashboard card, Data Display counted 1999 pages · 222 components, a Dashboard card, Data Display 20The Index must describe the library page for page — a gate checks it
Button Group pageNo segmented-button exampleAn arrangement: attached, the chosen option FilledShows the SC / OBC / SHREYAS switch designers asked for
Screen Templates page18 templates19: a DashboardScreen card and a desktop + phone frameThe new template is drawn where the other 18 are
Code ConnectNone for these partsA template and fixture for each of the sevenDev Mode shows the right code for each master
